audit.why: Emperor's Divide is flagged terrain — it blocks Lunar Rush pathing, which is the decisive late interaction and is already stated in content.late.

edits.before: Late Diana dives: E the carry through the front line, R the clump that collapses, and reset through the wreckage.
edits.after: Two items in, Emperor's Divide walls off your dash and his soldiers out-range you — catch him side lane or flank the wall.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Pale Cascade like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shifting Sands is 22s at rank 1 and 16s at rank 5 — his only escape; step up the moment he spends it. - Pale Cascade is 15s early: never walk up without orbs. - Emperor's Divide is 120s at rank 1 — bait it, then commit R.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: Three orbs on a 15s cooldown early — pop them as his soldier lands, and a third detonation adds strength to the shield you leave with.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Without Moonlight, Lunar Rush is a 22s cooldown at rank 1 with no refund — one dash in, no dash out, and his soldiers kite you dead.
